profile.summary: Idris Dot Solutions is a small company that offers laboratory automation services to biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, using liquid-handling robots, 3D printing and custom software. It also runs iConic, a set of technical workshops on laboratory robotics, 3D printing and software design for corporate and academic groups of all ages.
